body.p: Dyooa. Dyooa went home. When Dyooa came home, he said to the old woman: âThey took away my sokuy.â. Dyooa says: "I'll find the stump." Dyooa put on a parka again. Dyooa thinks, saying to himself: "People eat meat." Dyooa walks around people's tent places. Dyooa found a bone, a scapula bone. Dyooa said: "It would be good for me to make meat out of this." Dyooa froze the scapula bone with snow. Dyooa got blood from his nose. Then Dyooa smeared all the scapula with his blood. Dyooa made a reindeer scapula out of this. Dyooa took it home. Dyooa gave it to the old woman and said: "People will come soon. Boil this meat." After a while, people came indeed. Dyooa said: âOld woman, boil the cauldron!â. The old woman cooked it in a copper cauldron, the cauldron boiled. The guests are sitting. Dyooa said: "Take out the cauldron." The old woman started taking the things from the cauldron. The old woman took out the bone, the bone is white, there is no meat. Dyooa said: "Old woman, it seems that the guests have eaten my meat." Dyooa is quarrelling, he took out his bow and says to the people: âYou have eaten my meat. I'll show you, I'll kill you with a bow." The people got afraid and ran outside. People ran into the forest, ran away.[ShA:] SÉÊÉxiÊ is an unexpected form, middle sÉÊÉjxiÊ is expected. People left their clothes, their sokuys. Dyooa said: "I did this to you. My sokuy was taken away by the stump, but now I will take your clothes."
